description: Official station boards: delay, platform, cancel — not a journey planner.

env_var_specs.name: DB_TIMETABLES_CLIENT_ID
env_var_specs.description: Marketplace client id sent as DB-Client-Id. Also accepts DB_CLIENT_ID.

tools.name: fchg_get
tools.description: Fetch all known future changes for one station (evaNo). Returns Timetable XML with changed time/platform/status. Prefer board for a joined live board; use this only for the raw full-change feed. Required: evaNo.

tools.name: plan_get
tools.description: Fetch the static planned timetable for one station-hour. Required: evaNo, date (YYMMDD), hour (HH). Returns planned times/platforms only (no delays). Prefer board for the live overlay.

tools.name: rchg_get
tools.description: Fetch changes that became known in the last two minutes for one station (evaNo). Smaller than fchg. Prefer watch after a cached plan+fchg snapshot. Required: evaNo.

tools.name: station_get
tools.description: Look up stations by name prefix, EVA number, DS100/RL100 code, or wildcard. Returns station ids and names so you can resolve evaNo before board/plan/fchg. Required: pattern.

params.name: pattern
params.description: can be a station name (prefix), eva number, ds100/rl100 code, wildcard (*); doesn't seem to work with umlauten in station name (prefix)
